Bill.BriefDescription: Allocating federal surface transportation program enhancement funds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allocating federal surface transportationprogram enhancement funds; adding a new section to chapter 47.04 RCW;and adding a new section to chapter 47.80 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any steering committee that makes final selection of projectsfunded from federal surface transportation program enhancement funds ora similar program shall ensure, to the greatest extent practicable,that funding for each transportation enhancement activity is allocatedsuch that the allocation meets or exceeds the national average ofallocations made for each respective activity. The secretary oftransportation may not approve a project list submitted by the steeringcommittee unless it reflects allocation decisions that comply with thissection. For the purpose of this section, "transportation enhancementactivity" means the eligible project categories designated under 23U.S.C. Sec. 101(a)(35). (2) By December 1, 2007, and every two years thereafter, thedepartment shall report to the transportation committees of the p. 1 SB 6339legislature detailing the national average of allocations for eachtransportation enhancement activity and indicating whether the state'sallocations have met or exceeded the national average of allocationsmade for each respective activity.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.80 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any regional transportation planning organization that makesfunding recommendations regarding the selection of projects funded fromfederal surface transportation program enhancement funds or a similarprogram shall ensure, to the greatest extent practicable, that fundingfor each transportation enhancement activity is allocated such that theallocation meets or exceeds the national average of allocations madefor each respective activity. For the purpose of this section,"transportation enhancement activity" means the eligible projectcategories designated under 23 U.S.C. Sec. 101(a)(35).
